name: Re:Shape
source:
Imagine working a job you hate, inside a world you almost don't recognize.

Imagine encountering the friendliest monster to want to end the world.

Imagine being the only person who can save the world, and you've only got a 40-hour work week to do it.

Re:Shape is a visual novel about body horror in customer support, where you are tasked with saving the world from the friendliest AI assistant ever or die trying.

So dive into office drama, experience workplace romance, load up on awful staff kitchen coffee and discover the weird world that surrounds you, while avoiding the horrors that dwell outside your cubicle.

[Edited from [url=https://funigami.itch.io/reshape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，在一个你几乎不认识的世界里做着你讨厌的工作。

想象一下遇到最友好的怪物想要终结世界。

想象一下，你是唯一能够拯救世界的人，而你每周只有40小时的工作时间来做到这一点。

《Re:Shape》是一部关于客户支持中身体恐怖的视觉小说，你的任务是从有史以来最友好的人工智能助手手中拯救世界，否则就会死去。

因此，沉浸在办公室戏剧中，体验职场浪漫，喝上糟糕的员工厨房咖啡，探索你周围的奇怪世界，同时避免居住在你的小隔间之外的恐怖。

[编辑自[url=https://funigami.itch.io/reshape]Itch.io[/url]]
